title: Output Discipline Sets the Floor: A Falsification-Guided, Model-Agnostic Agent Protocol for Auditable Hypothesis-Driven Decision Making
abstract: arXiv:2610.18298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence? On the public TCMEval-SDT benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation (200 cases), the binding constraint is output discipline and reasoning structure, not model capability alone: two years of model scaling move zero-shot scores by only -0.03 to +0.08, while output-discipline failures (non-terminating reasoning, format non-compliance, large run-to-run spread) persist even in frontier models. We test this with a model-agnostic agent framework formalizing decision making as a five-stage closed loop, enforced by a candidate x evidence matrix falsification protocol: every candidate is judged against every evidence item, at least half of the candidates must be falsified before a conclusion is licensed, and survivors are emitted in a machine-verifiable single-line format. translated_title: 输出纪律决定下限：一种面向可审计假设驱动决策的证伪引导、模型无关智能体协议
translated_abstract: 在可审计的假设驱动决策任务上——即每个候选结论都可对照证据进行检验的任务——究竟是什么约束了大语言模型的表现？在公开的TCMEval-SDT中医辨证基准（200个案例）上，约束性因素是输出纪律与推理结构，而非单纯的模型能力：两年的模型规模扩展仅使零样本分数变动了-0.03至+0.08，而输出纪律失效问题（推理无法终止、格式不合规、运行间结果波动大）即便在最前沿的模型中依然存在。我们用一个模型无关的智能体框架来验证这一观点，该框架将决策形式化为五阶段闭环，并由“候选×证据”矩阵证伪协议加以强制执行：每个候选结论都必须对照每一条证据逐一判定，在结论被许可之前至少一半的候选必须被证伪，幸存的候选则以机器可验证的单行格式输出。在五（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现在可审计的假设驱动决策任务中，制约大语言模型表现的关键瓶颈是输出纪律与推理结构而非模型能力，并提出一种模型无关的五阶段闭环智能体框架，通过“候选×证据”矩阵证伪协议（至少证伪一半候选方可得出结论）和机器可验证的单行输出格式，实现可审计、可复现的决策。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies output discipline—not model capability—as the binding constraint on LLMs in auditable hypothesis-driven decision making, and proposes a model-agnostic five-stage closed-loop agent framework that enforces a candidate×evidence matrix falsification protocol with machine-verifiable single-line outputs.
